visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen is divided into a three-way split layout. The top left corner shows a tactical top-down mini-map from a MOBA game. The top right corner shows a female creator in a white hoodie focusing intently on her mobile device. The bottom half features high-intensity MOBA gameplay with colorful characters casting vibrant spells in a detailed forest environment. (2) Action intensifies in the bottom gameplay window as purple ability effects and glowing projectiles fill the frame. The creator in the top right exhibits micro-expressions of extreme focus, her mouth slightly agape and her eyes darting across her screen. Yellow and red health bars decrease rapidly above the game characters during the team fight. (3) A celebratory kill notification flashes on the game screen with bright gold effects. The streamer reacts by looking toward the camera and laughing, her hands continuing to move quickly on the phone. The lighting in her room is bright and professional, highlighting her expressive facial features against a plain white wall. (4) The gameplay sequence concludes with the character moving toward the home base. Large, variety-show style text blocks in Traditional Chinese overlay the center of the frame, emphasizing the streamer's final humorous remarks. She shifts her posture, leaning back in her red gaming chair while maintaining a triumphant smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic background music begins immediately with a steady, upbeat 4/4 tempo. A young female voice yells 'I'm coming!' in Traditional Chinese with high arousal and a bright, excited tone. Intense game-related sound effects, including magical explosions and percussive impacts, overlap heavily with the voice. (2) The speaker's voice becomes frantic and high-pitched, emitting a series of rapid-fire exclamations and non-verbal sounds of distress and effort. The BGM remains steady in the background, while the density of short, sharp impact SFX increases, simulating a complex battle scenario. The speaker's articulation remains clear despite the speech rate. (3) Transition to a slightly more descriptive tone as the speaker explains a gameplay mechanic involving 'three layers of marks.' A sudden 'Ding' sound effect occurs when a kill is secured. The BGM continues to provide a rhythmic foundation while the speaker's pitch fluctuates dramatically between focused commentary and triumphant shouting. (4) A loud, singular vocal burst 'R!' triggers a shift into a playful, repetitive chanting of 'Physical Immunity!' The BGM reaches its harmonic peak before a hard cut occurs in the vocal track. The video concludes with a lighthearted chuckle and a lower-intensity closing remark, while the electronic beat fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a gaming highlight reel designed to showcase the streamer's technical skill and charismatic, high-energy personality. By linking her real-time emotional reactions directly with intense MOBA gameplay, it aims to entertain an audience and build her brand as an engaging content creator.
